    • putProjectInBin

      @PUT @Path("{projectId: [0-9]+}/PutInBin") public void putProjectInBin(@PathParam("projectId") Long projectId)
      Put the given project in the bin. (= set DeletionStatus to BIN + set erasure tracking data)
      Parameters:
      projectId - the id of the project
      Throws:
      ch.colabproject.colab.generator.model.exceptions.HttpErrorMessage - if project does not exist

    • restoreProjectFromBin

      @PUT @Path("{projectId: [0-9]+}/RestoreFromBin") public void restoreProjectFromBin(@PathParam("projectId") Long projectId)
      Restore from the bin. The project won't contain any deletion or erasure data anymore.

      It means that the project is back at its place.

      Parameters:
      projectId - the id of the project
      Throws:
      ch.colabproject.colab.generator.model.exceptions.HttpErrorMessage - if project does not exist

    • flagProjectAsToDeleteForever

      @PUT @Path("{projectId: [0-9]+}/FlagAsToDeleteForever") public void flagProjectAsToDeleteForever(@PathParam("projectId") Long projectId)
      Set the deletion status to TO_DELETE.

      It means that the project is only visible in the bin panel.

      Parameters:
      projectId - the id of the project
      Throws:
      ch.colabproject.colab.generator.model.exceptions.HttpErrorMessage - if project does not exist
